thread:
Eli (new-hire): hey team, first week questions. SSH sessions to bastion keep freezing after ~7 minutes. I'm on a home ISP with a mesh router, using the WireGuard split-tunnel profile provided during onboarding. Anyone seen this pattern?

Riya (infra): welcome! yes, mesh/home NATs and split-tunnel DNS flips are common. two quick things: add ServerAliveInterval to your ssh config and ensure WireGuard's DNS is set to our internal resolver. can you paste your Host entry?

Eli (new-hire): here's my ~/.ssh/config for the host:

```
Host bastion-us-west
  HostName bastion.us-west-1.redwood
  User eli
  ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p jump.redwood
```

Jorge (it-support): on macs the resolver can fallback to the ISP if the client loses the WG route briefly. Make sure AllowedIPs includes the internal DNS subnet (10.0.4.0/24). If you can't edit the profile, add a /etc/resolver/redwood file pointing to 10.0.4.2 as a quick workaround.

Riya (infra): also change ProxyCommand -> ProxyJump and add:

```
  ServerAliveInterval 30
  ServerAliveCountMax 3
```

That helps with noisy NATs.

deploy-bot: rolling maintenance: bastion-us-west-3 scheduled reboot in 10m (maint-2026-05-02-3). Some sessions may drop.

oncall: confirmed, we are rolling reboots across the fleet. If you hit a disconnect, try `ssh bastion-us-west -J jump.redwood` to land on a different host.

Eli (new-hire): ok I switched to ProxyJump and added ServerAliveInterval. I also set the WG client DNS to 10.0.4.2. Still saw one freeze right at the maintenance window but nothing after. Git operations kept failing with "Could not resolve host" until I forced the internal DNS on WireGuard.

Jorge (it-support): noted. We'll push an updated split-tunnel profile for new hires that pins internal DNS and covers gitlab subnets. Also adding a note in the onboarding doc: "If using home router/mesh, prefer ServerAlive and use ProxyJump."

Eli (new-hire): great, thanks for the quick help! Appreciate the fast onboarding support. :tada:
